tutorial.trickDisplay: This is the current trick. You must follow the led suit. Trump cards are strongest.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Click a playable card to select it.
tutorial.playButton: Once a card is selected, play it with this button. Holding both K+Q of a suit lets you 'declare a marriage' for bonus points; four Kings or four Queens lets you 'declare Tute' for an instant win.
tutorial.info: A=11, 3=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2. Team A (seats 0 & 2) vs Team B (seats 1 & 3) fight for points; the first team to reach the target wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
